$comment: Flavor catalog — see docs/specs/02-microvm-runners.md & docs/specs/03-workflow-ingestion.md. All arm64/Graviton only. `memoryMb` is REQUESTED at image-build time as --resources minimumMemoryInMiB; `vcpu` is DESCRIPTIVE only — the GA lambda-microvms API exposes no vCPU knob (ADR-038).

flavors.name: base
flavors.label: lambda-ci
flavors.description: Ubuntu arm64 + GitHub Actions runner agent + git/curl/common toolchain.

flavors.name: node
flavors.label: lambda-ci-node
flavors.description: base + Node.js LTS toolchain (node/npm/pnpm/yarn) preinstalled for arm64, prebaked into the runner tool cache so actions/setup-node resolves from cache.

flavors.name: python
flavors.label: lambda-ci-python
flavors.description: base + CPython 3.12 (arm64) prebaked into the runner tool cache from the same actions/python-versions artifact actions/setup-python downloads, so setup-python resolves from cache.

flavors.name: java
flavors.label: lambda-ci-java
flavors.description: base + Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 LTS (aarch64) prebaked into the runner tool cache as Java_Temurin-Hotspot_jdk (setup-java's installer-class folder name, NOT the `distribution: temurin` input — ADR-053) so actions/setup-java resolves from cache. 8 GB — JVM builds (Gradle/Maven daemons) are the memory-hungriest of the standard set.

flavors.name: go
flavors.label: lambda-ci-go
flavors.description: base + pinned Go toolchain (arm64) prebaked into the runner tool cache so actions/setup-go resolves from cache, plus a C toolchain for cgo.

flavors.name: rust
flavors.label: lambda-ci-rust
flavors.description: base + pinned Rust stable via rustup (rustc/cargo/clippy/rustfmt, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) on PATH. No tool-cache entry — the Rust actions drive rustup, not the runner tool cache. 8 GB for link-heavy release builds.

flavors.name: docker
flavors.label: lambda-ci-docker
flavors.description: base + Docker engine (rootful daemon started per-job, runner in docker group) for container:/services: jobs and docker build/run, arm64 images. Larger footprint (8 GB requested). Needs additionalOsCapabilities=ALL so dockerd can mount cgroup2 (ADR-020).
